properties.name: expanded
properties.comment: Whether the page's expanded information shows (Windows Forms' TaskDialogExpander.Expanded); a view onto the page's expander. A change re-lays out the dialog and raises expanded_changed; a write to a page without an expander does nothing and reads false.
hand: a view onto page_.expander: write_view updates the expander button and the expanded text, invalidates the dialog and its layer, and raises expanded_changed

properties.name: verification_checked
properties.comment: The verification check box's state (Windows Forms' TaskDialogVerificationCheckBox.Checked); a view onto the page. While the check box exists a write goes through it and raises verification_changed; before it does, a write only stores the page's state.
hand: a view onto page_.verification_checked, written through the check box while it exists

not_properties.name: set_progress_value(value)
not_properties.reason: page-scoped: its only storage is the page's optional progress bar, a write without one is dropped and nothing reads it back (Windows Forms puts Value on TaskDialogProgressBar)

not_properties.name: surface
not_properties.reason: a presentation choice read at the next show(), set noexcept without a touch
